units.source_text: 末摘花是常陆亲王的女公子，身份甚高，源氏常觉很委屈她。

en.t: Suetsumuhana was the daughter of Prince Hitachi and of very high rank, and Genji often felt that her circumstances were unfairly beneath her.

units.source_text: 因此凡外人耳目所及之事，都替她办得十分体面，以免受人轻视。

en.t: For that reason, in all matters visible to outsiders, he arranged everything for her with great propriety so that she would not be looked down upon.

units.source_text: 末摘花一头青丝发从前又长又密，但近年来已渐变衰，

en.t: Suetsumuhana's black hair had once been long and thick, but in recent years it had gradually lost its former abundance,

units.source_text: 从侧影望去，竟可看见交混着白发，令人想起古人“奔腾泻瀑布”之歌，不胜惋惜。

en.t: and when seen in profile, strands of white hair could even be seen mingled in it, recalling the old poem about a rushing waterfall and filling one with regret.

units.source_text: 源氏连正面也不敢细看。

en.t: Genji could not even bring himself to look closely at her face from the front.

units.source_text: 她身穿源氏所赠的藤蔓花纹、白面绿里的外衣。

en.t: She wore an outer robe that Genji had given her, patterned with wisteria vines, white on the outside and green-lined within.

units.source_text: 然而似乎很不相称，想是人的气质所使然。

en.t: Yet it seemed quite unbecoming on her, perhaps because of her own bearing and nature.

units.source_text: 这外衣里面穿着一件暗淡无光而硬若纸板的深红色衬衣，样子甚是寒酸，令人看了觉得不快。

en.t: Under this robe she wore a dark red undergarment, dull and lusterless and stiff as cardboard, so shabby in appearance that it was unpleasant to see.

units.source_text: 源氏曾经送她许多衬衣，不知她为何不穿。

en.t: Genji had once sent her many undergarments, and he could not understand why she did not wear them.

units.source_text: 只有那鼻尖上的红色，春霞也遮不住，依旧鲜艳夺目。

en.t: Only the red at the tip of her nose, which even the spring haze could not conceal, remained as vivid and striking as ever.

units.source_text: 源氏不知不觉地叹一口气，特地把帷屏拉拢些，以求隔远。

en.t: Genji sighed despite himself and deliberately drew the screen a little closer, trying to put more distance between them.

units.source_text: 但末摘花并不介意。

en.t: But Suetsumuhana did not mind at all.

units.source_text: 她多年来蒙源氏深切关怀，生活十分安稳，因此全心全意地信赖他，这态度实甚可怜。

en.t: For many years she had received Genji's devoted care and lived in great security, so she trusted him with all her heart, an attitude that was truly pitiable.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得这个人不但相貌特殊，连态度也与众不同，真乃可悲之事。

en.t: Genji felt that this woman was unusual not only in appearance but even in manner, and that it was a deeply sad thing.

units.source_text: 又念如此可怜之人，倘连我也不照顾她，不知更将何等受苦。

en.t: He also thought that if even he failed to look after such a pitiable person, there was no telling how much more she would suffer.

units.source_text: 便决心永远保护她。

en.t: So he resolved to protect her forever.

units.source_text: 这也是一片仁慈恻隐之心。

en.t: This too came from a heart of kindness and compassion.

units.source_text: 她的声音也很凄凉，说话时颤抖不定。

en.t: Her voice too was very forlorn, and when she spoke it trembled unsteadily.

units.source_text: 源氏看得不耐烦了，对她言道：“你难道连照料衣服的人也没有么？

en.t: Genji could no longer bear the sight and said to her, "Do you not even have anyone to look after your clothes?

units.source_text: 这里没有外人进来，生活甚是安适，你尽可随心所欲，多穿几件柔软的厚实的衣服，何必一味讲究服装的外表呢？”

en.t: No outsiders come in here, and your life is quite comfortable, so you may dress as you please and wear several soft, warm layers. Why concern yourself only with the outward appearance of your clothes?"

units.source_text: 末摘花只得笨拙地笑着答道：“醍醐的阿阇梨要我照顾衣服等事，因此自己没有工夫缝衣服了。

en.t: Suetsumuhana could only smile awkwardly and answer, "The Ajari of Daigo has me take care of clothes and such things, so I have no time to sew garments for myself.

units.source_text: 我那件毛皮衫也被他拿了去，冬天很冷呢。”

en.t: He even took away my fur robe, and winter is very cold."

units.source_text: 这阿阇梨是她的哥哥，鼻子也是很红的。

en.t: This Ajari was her elder brother, and his nose too was very red.

units.source_text: 她对源氏说这些话，可见真心信赖，毫不掩饰。

en.t: That she said such things to Genji showed that she truly trusted him and concealed nothing.

units.source_text: 但也不免过于直率了。

en.t: Even so, it was unavoidably too frank.

units.source_text: 源氏在她面前不复说笑，只是装出一本正经的模样，说道：“毛皮衫送给他，很好。

en.t: Genji no longer joked in front of her, but put on a perfectly serious expression and said, "It was good to give him the fur robe.

units.source_text: 可给这位山僧当衲裰衣穿。

en.t: It can serve this mountain monk as a patched priestly robe.

units.source_text: 你不妨把那些不足惜的白色衬衣穿它七层八层，便很暖和了。

en.t: You might as well put on seven or eight layers of those white undergarments that are not worth sparing, and then you will be quite warm.

units.source_text: 你有需要之时，倘我忘记送来，你尽管告诉我。

en.t: Whenever you need something, if I forget to send it, tell me without hesitation.

units.source_text: 我这个人又糊涂，又懒散，加之事情纷忙，自然容易疏忽。”

en.t: I am muddleheaded and lazy, and on top of that I am busy with many affairs, so naturally I am apt to be negligent."

units.source_text: 便命打开二条院的库房，取出许多绫绢来送她。

en.t: He then ordered the storehouses at Nijo-in opened and had many brocades and silks taken out and sent to her.

units.source_text: 这东院并非荒僻之处，但因主人不住在此地，环境自然岑寂。

en.t: This eastern residence was not a desolate place, but because its master did not live there, the surroundings were naturally quiet and lonely.

units.source_text: 只有庭前的树木欣欣向荣，红梅初开，芬芳扑鼻，却无人欣赏。

en.t: Only the trees before the garden flourished vigorously; the red plum had just begun to bloom and its fragrance filled the air, yet there was no one to admire it.

units.source_text: 源氏看了这红梅，自言自语地吟道：

en.t: Looking at this red plum, Genji murmured a poem to himself:
